crossRefs.note: The land trembles and is in pain; for the purposes of Yahweh against Babylon stand, to make the land of Babylon a…
Babylon will become heaps, a dwelling place for jackals, an astonishment, and a hissing, without inhabitant.
Therefore the wild animals of the desert with the wolves will dwell there. The ostriches will dwell therein; and it…
As when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and its neighbor cities,” says Yahweh, “so no man will dwell there, neither…
They didn’t say, ‘Where is Yahweh who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, who led us through the wilderness…
It will never be inhabited, neither will it be lived in from generation to generation. The Arabian will not pitch a…
therefore, behold, I am against you, and against your rivers. I will make the land of Egypt an utter waste and…
No foot of man will pass through it, nor will any animal foot pass through it. It won’t be inhabited for forty years.

translations.web: Her cities have become a desolation, a dry land, and a desert, a land in which no man dwells. No son of man passes by it.
translations.bsb: Her cities have become a desolation, a dry and arid land, a land where no one lives, where no son of man passes through.
translations.kjv: Her cities are a desolation, a dry land, and a wilderness, a land wherein no man dwelleth, neither doth any son of man pass thereby.
translations.asv: Her cities are become a desolation, a dry land, and a desert, a land wherein no man dwelleth, neither doth any son of man pass thereby.
